paper_title: One Tokenizer To Rule Them All Emergent Language Plasticity via   Multilingual Tokenizers
caption: : Effect of vocabulary size.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of two tokenizers, “universal” and “cluster”, as a function of vocabulary size. The x-axis is labeled “100k” to “250k” and employs a linear scale, with tick marks spaced approximately every 50k units. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and ranges from 40.0 to 42.0, with a tick interval of 0.5%. The blue line represents the “universal” tokenizer, starting at a value of approximately 40.6 at 100k and decreasing to 41.2 at 250k. The orange line represents the “cluster” tokenizer, beginning at a value of approximately 41.3 at 100k and ending at a value of approximately 41.8 at 250k.
